title: Download Spatial Datasets of Peru
text: geoperu provides official spatial datasets Peru sf objects. includes administrative boundaries published National Institute Statistics Informatics (INEI), plus protected natural areas SERNANP. returned objects work directly ggplot2, dplyr, wider spatial R ecosystem.

title: Download Spatial Datasets of Peru
text: Use get_geo_peru() download administrative boundaries. geography accepts one names, case-insensitively. Use "" retrieve every unit chosen level. example, retrieve single department, departments, one province: request needs multiple files, geoperu downloads missing files concurrently reuses files cached R session. national map, prefer simplified = TRUE; transfers plots far less geometry. objects returned geoperu work directly ggplot2. restrained grey scale, fine district borders, geographic grid produce clear, technical map Cusco:

title: Download Spatial Datasets of Peru
text: get_anp_peru() downloads protected natural areas declared National Service Natural Areas Protected State (SERNANP).  maps use ggplot2; colors, typography, line widths can adapted without modifying spatial data.

title: Download Spatial Data of Protected Natural Areas (ANP) in Peru — get_anp_peru
text: Downloads spatial data protected natural areas Peru declared SERNANP (National Service Natural Areas Protected State). Data obtained SERNANP Geographic Information Viewer official source. data use WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

title: Download Spatial Data of Protected Natural Areas (ANP) in Peru — get_anp_peru
Download Spatial Data of Protected Natural Areas (ANP) in Peru — get_anp_peru
text: anp character vector name(s) protected natural areas Peru. showProgress Logical TRUE FALSE display progress bar download.

text: "sf" "data.frame" object containing spatial data Peru's protected natural areas.

what: Download spatial data of Peru — get_geo_peru
title: Download spatial data of Peru — get_geo_peru
text: Downloads spatial data Peru using WGS 84 geodetic reference system (EPSG:4326).

title: Download spatial data of Peru — get_geo_peru
code: get_geo_peru(   geography = "all",   level = "all",   simplified = TRUE,   showProgress = TRUE )

title: Download spatial data of Peru — get_geo_peru
text: geography character vector name geographical region. Use "" request geographic units selected level. level character: "" national data, "dep" departments, "prov" provinces. Together geography = "", options return one national dataset, 25 departments, 196 provinces, respectively. simplified logical TRUE FALSE, select data districts polygon simplified higher level. showProgress Logical TRUE FALSE display progress bar download.

code: if (interactive()) { # Read specific province anta <- get_geo_peru(geography = "ANTA",                      level = "prov",                      simplified = TRUE)  }

title: Districts of Peru — peru
text: sf object containing district-level administrative boundaries Peru WGS 84 coordinate reference system (EPSG:4326).

title: Districts of Peru — peru
text: sf object 1,874 rows four variables: departamento Department name. provincia Province name. distrito District name. geometry Polygon geometry.

title: geoperu 0.0.2
text: get_geo_peru() downloads multiple selected files concurrently, reducing wait departments provinces. get_geo_peru() now returns departments provinces geography = "" used respective level. Made downloads atomic validated HTTP responses caching files. Improved error messages unavailable, empty, malformed remote data. Removed duplicate network requests consolidated GeoPackage downloads. Added argument validation expanded automated tests. Updated documentation CRAN metadata.
